launch_authorization.scope: CPU stimulus rendering (MAESTRO excerpts x 12 variants x 2 soundfonts), MERT-v1-95M + random-weight control + AES features, chroma/madmom rule baselines, linear/MLP heads and T1/T2/T3 test readout for 178. No generation, no training of the TTM systems.

question: Without being shown the original, can MERT features decide which of two rendered versions of the same 10 s MAESTRO excerpt had notes changed (wrong notes inside the MIDI distribution)?

fixed_protocol.prereg: docs/experiments/wrongnote_probe_mert_178_20261103.md (frozen; no criterion changed in this job)
fixed_protocol.variants_note: 4 ok + 8 wrong = 12 per excerpt-font. 'transpose' is +-1 randomly signed, 'tempo' is +-3% randomly signed, 'gain_m6' is the clean audio scaled -6 dB (no re-render). These are the on-disk manifest names; the manifest is the authority
fixed_protocol.features: MERT-v1-95M revision 12af15fef9d0ac838c3f475bfbbf26d2060dd4f5, 13 hidden-state means; random-weight MERT seed 0; AES CE/CU/PC/PQ; rule baselines chroma-cqt out-of-key ratio and madmom key_cnn_conf
fixed_protocol.heads: per-layer L2 logistic (C chosen on val), best layer chosen on val, MLP secondary; test evaluated once
fixed_protocol.endpoints: T1 AUC (2000-cluster bootstrap CI), T2 pairwise pick-original, T3 false alarms at p>=0.5

deviations.D1: prereg asks for 150 val / 250 test excerpts each from a distinct performance, but MAESTRO v3 has only 137 validation and 177 test performances with >= 20 notes in a 10 s window. The registered excerpt counts are kept: the shortfall is filled with a second non-overlapping window from a distinct performance, and the bootstrap clusters by performance (documented in the results deviations section).
deviations.D2: T3 false-alarm threshold is p >= 0.5 on the head's predicted probability (prereg does not fix the operating point for T3; 0.5 is the only point used for every arm).
deviations.D3: The 'best non-oracle control' is the control with the highest test AUC (max over controls), which is the strictest reading of 'best'.
deviations.D4: The symbolic oracle out-of-scale ratio is computed against the key estimated once on the clean excerpt, so transpose variants carry a shifted key on purpose; the oracle is only used as a reference column, never for tuning.
deviations.D5: madmom contributes key_cnn_conf only (no beat tracking), matching the 133/126d usage of mir_metrics.py.
deviations.D6: The MLP secondary head is trained on the layer chosen for the linear head, not re-selected per head (one selection on val, no extra test peeking).

resume.note: stage-level restart: stimuli skip FLACs already on disk, features skip finished chunks, rules skip scored paths

completion_evidence.method: guest writes terminal with sha256 of the registered run.json and summary.json after --validate-only passes
